verdict.rationale: Plausible auto-tracks pageviews and scroll depth with no code, and can auto-track file downloads, form completions, and outbound link clicks via 'goals' with no code, plus SPA route changes are supported out of the box. However, generic 'clicks' beyond outbound links and full custom form/event capture still require enabling specific goal types or the Events API/custom code for anything beyond the built-in automatic goals, so it's not a fully code-free universal event capture system. missing for 10: evidence of fully automatic generic click tracking (not just outbound links), hands-on/independent confirmation that form interaction tracking works without any configuration, and clarity on limits of the 'no code' claim for custom events.
